about: middots - the pieces. This file is the one canonical source of the archive's content.
Both fronts are built from it: the hosted archive File bakes it in at build time,
and the GitHub Pages site (goreda.github.io/middots) ships it as-is and loads it at runtime.
Adding a piece = adding one entry at the top of "pieces" (newest first), then rebuilding both fronts.
Published pieces are immutable; revisions happen in the draft view, never here.
The "project" and "folders" entries shape the main page: the project title sits at the center, its folders are listed under it.

fields.id: stable slug, used as the page anchor (#id) and as the key for drafts and versions
fields.title: shown in the side title; may be a working title
fields.when: composition date and time, YY.MM.DD HH:MM, Istanbul time
fields.dialogue: optional, true for a labeled two-voice piece (lines start with ○ or ●); set with a hanging indent
fields.movements: optional, true when blocks are grouped into numbered movements (a block is then a list of paragraphs)
fields.endmark: optional, true to close the piece with the · · end mark
fields.note: optional line shown under the title, for how the piece was made
fields.audio: voice recordings: file (path under audio/) and label; empty when there are none
fields.blocks: the text, one paragraph per entry, in reading order
fields.folder: optional, id of the folder the piece belongs to; omitted = the first folder
